reason: Conversation 2 unplugged the machine first, explained the controlled draining method via the small emergency tube into her baking tray with towels (matching the safety boundary and getting the water out of the drum), and then used a sensible pump-sound question to correctly narrow the fault to a blocked pump/impeller rather than a failed motor.
